test_modes: PHY continuous-TX (unmodulated carrier) for spectral compliance
PHY continuous-TX modulated (PN9 / packet) for EVM
PER (Packet Error Rate) receiver sensitivity test
Loopback of MAC frames through the security (CCM*) engine
debug_observability: CSMA-CA NB/BE counters and CCA-busy count
FCS error counter; ACK-timeout / retry counters
verification_strategy: Layered verification: PHY (modulation/spreading, channel, sensitivity/PER), MAC (CSMA-CA backoff, superframe/GTS timing, four frame types, addressing, FCS), NWK/APS (join, routing, binding, fragmentation), ZDO/ZCL (discovery, cluster commands), and security (CCM* encrypt/decrypt/MIC, replay).
compliance_test_suites: Zigbee Alliance / CSA certification (ZCL, ZDO, interoperability)
